alignment_reasoning: The Fine-Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class 'jean' (Logit 7.5 vs 1.94 for next best). All testable functional components (rivets, stitching, fly button, belt loops) are present and correctly formed. The image conforms well to the taxonomy despite the cropping. The score is deducted slightly because the 'twill weave' is not distinctly visible due to the smudging artifact, making the material verification less than perfect.
